subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI `code_execution` and `x_search` fail closed unless `ctx.activeModel.provider` is `xai`, or should intentional cross-provider use remain possible behind an explicit opt-in?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the PR changes default availability for credential-backed provider-billed tools and for contexts missing active-model metadata.

options.title: Fail closed after coverage and docs
options.body: Accept the safer default, but require current-head factory tests, aligned docs, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Add explicit cross-provider opt-in
options.body: Preserve intentional non-xAI-model use only through a visible documented opt-in so the billing boundary is not implicit.

options.title: Pause for policy issue
options.body: Keep the linked issue canonical until maintainers decide the broader provider-billed tool policy.

recommendation.title: Fail closed after coverage and docs
recommendation.body: Accept the safer default, but require current-head factory tests, aligned docs, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a provider/plugin boundary and active-model policy choice, and the history shows substantial adjacent ownership there.
